summary: First-pass frontend-only smoke + e2e test of the 'Papelería · Acomodo' mini-Canva app. All 14 frontend flows from the request were exercised end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. Every flow passed: initial load + UI scaffolding, image upload via file-input (6 dummy PNGs of varied dimensions injected through DataTransfer), all 5 layouts (Auto-fit, Media hoja, 2×2, 3×3, 4×4), paper size + orientation change (Carta→Oficio + Vertical→Horizontal updating both indicator and canvas proportions), guillotine mode toggle (purple dashed border verified) + 'g' keyboard shortcut, placement selection opens selection-editor in right sidebar, fit-cover activates object-fit=cover and exposes zoom + offset sliders, Delete key removes selected placement, clear-canvas-button removes placements but keeps thumbnails, clear-all-button shows confirm() and wipes both, and Export dropdown shows PDF/PNG/JPG options. object-fit was verified to be 'contain' on auto-fit (i.e. no image deformation, fulfilling the critical aspect-ratio rule). Ctrl+V paste was not simulated (clipboard image injection blocked in headless), but the listener exists in PrinterApp.jsx and did not throw. All UI strings observed are in Spanish.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx line 43: destructured 'setGuillotine: _setG' is a dead/duplicated alias (setGuillotine already destructured on line 35). Harmless but should be removed.
ImageBox.jsx: empty useEffect with comment 'nothing' (lines 151-153) should be deleted.

PrinterApp.jsx ShortcutsAndPasteBinder: 'g' shortcut directly compares against stale 'guillotine' from closure; works because effect re-binds on every change, but a functional setter (setGuillotine(g => !g)) would be cleaner and avoid future race conditions.
Canvas.jsx onDrop: clamps xPct/yPct to 0..70 hardcoded based on default wPct/hPct=30; if those defaults change this will silently break.
All testable elements have data-testids — good. No backend integration to review (100% frontend by design).
seed_data_creation: 6 dummy PNG images generated client-side via canvas.toBlob and pushed into file-input.files via DataTransfer at test runtime (no persistence, app is frontend-only)
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% frontend (React/CRA + Tailwind, no API). Use file-input with a DataTransfer approach to seed images (see iteration_1 script). data-testids are comprehensive and reliable. The export dropdown actions trigger real downloads via html2canvas + jsPDF — skip executing them in headless; only verify the dropdown opens. Selection-editor only mounts when a placement is selected. 'Limpiar todo' uses window.confirm — register a dialog handler before clicking. The 'paper-size-legal' SelectItem has testid 'paper-size-legal' (option pattern is paper-size-${id}).
